newsitem.title: UK: BRIGHT-BRITON EYES RECORD IN CHARITY ANTARCTICA TREK.
newsitem.headline: BRIGHT-BRITON EYES RECORD IN CHARITY ANTARCTICA TREK.

text.p: LONDON - British explorer Ranulph Fiennes said he hopes to become the first man to walk solo and unaided across Antarctica.

During an 1,800 mile (2,900 km) journey that will begin on November 1, he will drag 500 lb (227 kg) of equipment by sledge to raise three million sterling ($4.7 million) for the breast cancer charity Breakthrough.
He will leave Berkner Island in the north of Antarctica, travel via the South Pole and the Filchner Ice Shelf and arrive 110 days later at Scott Base in the southwest of the continent.
